subject: Instant throughput boost request + billing alignment for mid-June campaign
messages:
From: Lena Morales <lena@brightwave.ai>
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com
Cc: procurement@brightwave.ai
Date: 2025-06-12 09:15 PDT
Subject: Quick ask — capacity spike next week (need short-term uplift)

Hi Olga,

We have a 72-hour paid media push starting June 18 that will drive a 6x token throughput vs baseline. Our engineers are getting throttled on the start day and asked me to reach out — we need an "instant uplift" for roughly 48–72 hours, with predictable billing so our finance team can reconcile.

Questions:
- Can Redwood provision a short-window throughput boost for 48–72 hours?
- How will billing work — one-off true-up, provisional surcharge, or short-term bump in committed throughput?
- Any options for a fixed uplift credit or blended rate so we don't get a surprise invoice?

I've attached last week's spike CSV and a quick token projection. Procurement is looped in for approvals. We can sign an SOW if that helps.

Thanks,
Lena Morales
Head of ML Ops, Brightwave Media

Brightwave Media | lena@brightwave.ai | +1 415-555-0119

From: olga_petrov@redwood.com
To: Lena Morales <lena@brightwave.ai>
Cc: ben_carter@redwood.com, marissa_cole@redwood.com
Date: 2025-06-12 10:02 PDT
Subject: Re: Quick ask — capacity spike next week (need short-term uplift)

Lena — thanks for the heads up and the data, that helps a lot. Short answer: yes, we can provide a controlled short-window uplift. I'd like to lay out two pragmatic paths so procurement can choose what fits Brightwave's billing preferences: 

1) Short-window Headroom subscription (recommended) — a temporary 72-hour "buffer" subscription we enable in advance. Pricing: flat uplift fee based on peak QPS projection + a smoothing credit if actual usage is below projection. This gives you predictable dollars and avoids large per-token overrun invoices.

2) One-off Overrun True-up — we let you exceed thresholds for the window and then issue a reconciled invoice at a blended overrun rate. Simpler operationally, but invoices can be noisy.

Two immediate asks from our side:
- Confirm the exact UTC start/end you want enabled (we'll schedule the capacity).
- Tell us whether procurement prefers a flat uplift fee or a reconciled true-up.

Ben — can you pull a quick estimate for a 6x multiplier across their June 18–20 window (attached projection) and propose a 72-hour uplift fee vs blended overrun price? Marissa, finance will want the invoicing flow — can you outline the billing milestone for SOW vs ad-hoc true-up?

I'll draft a short SOW template we can sign electronically once we agree.

Best,
Olga Petrov
Senior Account Executive, Redwood Inference
olga@redwood.com
Office: +1 212-555-0234

From: ben_carter@redwood.com
To: olga_petrov@redwood.com, Lena Morales <lena@brightwave.ai>

Date: 2025-06-12 11:08 PDT
Subject: Re: Quick ask — capacity spike next week (need short-term uplift)

Thanks, Olga. Quick pricing sketch (ballpark) based on the token-projection.xlsx: 

- Baseline: ~1.2M tokens/day. Projected spike: ~7.2M tokens/day for 3 days.
- Option A (72-hr headroom subscription): flat fee = $6,500 for the 72-hour window (covers 7.2M/day peak headroom), with a "smoothing credit" back to Brightwave if actual usage is >10% under projection. This gets you predictable spend and a single invoice line.
- Option B (Overrun True-up): standard PAYG rate + 25% peak surcharge for tokens beyond committed threshold. Estimated true-up invoice ~ $7,800 (higher variance).

Discounts: If Brightwave signs a 3-month mini-commit for similar monthly headroom windows, we can extend a 10% loyalty discount on uplift fees going forward.

Operational notes: we can pre-authorize the uplift (no infra changes required on your side). We'll provision in the us-east region unless you prefer eu-west.

Lena — which option do you want quoted into the SOW? I can generate a redlined SOW PDF by EOD.

Ben Carter
Dir, Strategic Accounts — Redwood Inference

- Will the smoothing credit be applied automatically on reconciliation or require a credit memo request?
- Please include an explicit cancellation window (we need 24-hour cancellation notice).

Attaching procurement's quick SOW checklist. We'll need the SOW + invoice details in time to approve by June 16.

Hi all — quick finance notes: 
- Audit trail: yes, we'll provide a CSV export of token-level usage for the uplift window and a signed statement of reconciliation. That export will be stored in your vendor portal for 90 days by default; if you need longer retention we can add that to the SOW as an optional line item.
- Smoothing credit: applied automatically at reconciliation and will reduce the uplift invoice; we'll include a reconciliation line item in the final invoice so you don't have to request a separate credit memo.
- Cancellation: 24-hour notice is fine. We'll reflect that clause in the SOW.

Ben — please attach the SOW draft and an invoice template. Olga, I'll approve the billing approach once SOW wording is confirmed.

Marissa Cole
